import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(35.0, 0, -1.5), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
    .rect(70.0, 16.0)
    .extrude(3.0)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(70.0, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 90, 0))
            .rect(3.0, 16.0)
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 10.2), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 90))
            .rect(3.0, 16.0)
            .loft(combine=True)
    )
    .cut(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(17.5, 0, -1.7), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .circle(2.5)
            .extrude(3.4)
    )
    .cut(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(52.5, 0, -1.7), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .circle(2.5)
            .extrude(3.4)
    )
)
show_object(result)

import cadquery as cq
first_flange = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(35.0, 0, -1.5), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
    .rect(70.0, 16.0)
    .extrude(3.0)
    .cut(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=-1.7)
        .pushPoints([(17.5, 0), (52.5, 0)])
        .circle(2.5)
        .extrude(3.4)
    )
)
twisted_web = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(70.0, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 90, 0))
    .rect(3.0, 16.0)
    .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 10.2), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 90))
    .rect(3.0, 16.0)
    .loft(combine=True)
)
result = first_flange.union(twisted_web)
show_object(result)
